definitions.gloss: (after a noun) containing; with ... in it
definitions.explanation: Attached to a noun, it means that something contains or comes with that thing: {砂糖|さとう}{入|い}り (with sugar), ミルク{入|い}り (with milk), {写真|しゃしん}{入|い}り (with photos). After a number it gives the quantity in a pack: {十個|じっこ}{入|い}り (ten in a pack).

definitions.gloss: entering; the start of a period or season
definitions.explanation: The act of entering, and the point at which a period begins: {梅雨|つゆ}{入|い}り (start of the rainy season), {寒|かん}の{入|い}り (start of the coldest season). It also appears in {日|ひ}の{入|い}り (sunset), when the sun goes in.

definitions.gloss: attendance; the size of the audience
definitions.explanation: How many people come to a show, game or shop: {客|きゃく}の{入|い}りがいい (the turnout is good). It can also mean income coming in, as in {入|い}りが{少|すく}ない (little money coming in).

examples.japanese: ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧。

notes:
{入|い}り is the noun form of {入|い}る, an older and now mostly bound form of ⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter), which survives in compounds and set phrases. As a suffix it is read ⟦いり→いる：00495_iru⟧, never はいり.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧: a box containing ~
- {梅雨|つゆ}{入|い}り / {寒|かん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入|い}り: start of the rainy / cold season
- {日|ひ}の{入|い}り: sunset (opposite ⟦{日|ひ}の{出|で}→日の出：17596_hinode⟧)
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入|い}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ / ⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: the turnout is good / poor
- {仲間|なかま}{入|い}り: joining a group

WATCH OUT:
With a following noun, 〜{入|い}り usually takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: ⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧{入|い}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紅茶|こうちゃ}→紅茶：02878_koucha⟧. Don't confuse it with {入|はい}り{口|ぐち} (entrance), which uses the はいる reading.
